title.purpose: Heading of the panel that holds the audio model's guesses and its Sounds like list.
title.where: Track details, after What's next, when the audio model is on.

opinion.purpose: Says the panel shows the model's opinion only and changes nothing on the track.
opinion.where: Track details, under the Audio model heading.

genre.purpose: Label for the model's genre guesses.

mood.purpose: Label for the model's mood guess.

guess.purpose: One guess: a genre or mood name and the model's confidence in percent.
guess.where: Audio model section, genre and mood lines.

noGenre.purpose: Says the model has no genre guess for this track, so it isn't read as a fault.

noMood.purpose: Says the model has no mood guess for this track, so it isn't read as a fault.

similar.title.purpose: Heading of the list of Library tracks the audio model hears as close to the selected one.

similar.track.purpose: A track in the Sounds like list: its artist and title.
similar.track.where: Audio model section, each Sounds like track.

similar.percent.purpose: How close a track sounds to the selected one, in percent.
similar.percent.where: Audio model section, beside each Sounds like track.

similar.empty.purpose: Says no other Library track has been listened to enough to compare, so it isn't read as a fault.
similar.empty.where: Audio model section, under Sounds like.

loading.purpose: Shown while the panel's guesses or list are being read.

state.notListened_one.purpose: Says the selected track hasn't been listened to yet and how far the listening has got (one track in all).

state.notListened_other.purpose: Says the selected track hasn't been listened to yet and how far the listening has got.

state.couldntRead.purpose: Says the model couldn't read this track's audio.

state.notInLibrary.purpose: Says only Library tracks are listened to, for a track that isn't in the Library.

switch.label.purpose: Name of the switch for the audio model.

switch.help.purpose: Says what the audio model gives, that it runs on this computer and sends nothing, and that listening takes a while in the background.
switch.help.where: Settings, Optional features, under the Audio model switch.

switch.error.purpose: Says the switch couldn't be saved.
switch.error.where: Settings, Optional features, under the Audio model switch.

switch.noTracks.purpose: Says the Library has no tracks for the model to listen to yet.

switch.progress_one.purpose: How many Library tracks have been listened to (one track in all).

switch.progress_other.purpose: How many Library tracks have been listened to.

switch.failed_one.purpose: Says how many tracks the model couldn't read (one).

switch.failed_other.purpose: Says how many tracks the model couldn't read.

switch.running.purpose: Says the listening is going on in the background.

switch.paused.purpose: Says the listening isn't running now although tracks are left (paused, or a drive is unplugged).

switch.finished.purpose: Says every Library track has been listened to or couldn't be read.
